notes:
v1.17.1 Release:
- Transcribe and translate are fast again with many API keys: v1.17.0 gave up on Gemini after 65 seconds, while a whole tab takes 1.5-3 minutes, so most tabs were cut off, asked again and used up the keys' per-minute limits. The app now waits up to 4 minutes again, like v1.16.0
- Check limits answers sooner when Google is overloaded

New in v1.17.0:
- Gemini Web Router: use spare Gmails on gemini.google.com instead of API keys. Line times are measured on your PC, so they land on the speech
- DR Router PRO: a pool of accounts with a live dashboard, a proxy for each account, and a local proxy that moves on to the next ready key
- No subtitle goes out silent: lines still without Khmer are asked again and voiced, and anything still silent pauses the series and tells you where
- Dub Whole Series: "Each episode its own tab" mode, a pick of which episodes to dub, a progress row for each episode, "Episodes at once" and "Retry failed", tabs cut where an episode ends, and an option to delete the working files after export
- Honest key limits: "Not checked today", live countdowns, a Resting group, Check limits, and removing dead keys in one click
- Fewer Gemini requests: episodes share their review requests, and the app waits out "high demand" instead of trying every key
- Faster exports: a blur height for each subtitle line, two exports at once, and joining a series is much faster when only a few episodes differ

Also new since v1.6.0:
- v1.16.0: Edge voices say the words they kept getting wrong correctly, fixed automatically
- v1.15.0: voices start with their subtitle however far Transcribe drifts, a notice on screen is not read as the subtitles, no double voices
- v1.14.0: one voice per character however Gemini spells them, Remove music from BGM, NVIDIA decoding for exports
- v1.13.0: series survives a power cut or lost Wi-Fi, every subtitle voiced, export colours match the preview
- v1.12.0: one voice per character, faster blur exports, overlays and ads removed
- v1.11.0: VoxCPM2 lines said like the actor, 4x faster lines, better Khmer reading
- v1.10.0: the export matches the editor
- v1.9.0: emotions for imported SRTs and on the voice pill, VoxCPM2 Khmer voice, series export folder
- v1.8.0: VoxCPM2 voice capture and voice groups, Fix Rushed Lines, Khmer pronouns
- v1.7.0: Khmer interface, Join into one video, Gemini model changes
